content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, letting our hands linger together ||| "What if we turned this into our secret?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Pull my hand back, breaking the connection ||| "No, Julian. This isn’t a game; I need clarity."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, vulnerability spilling out ||| "I still believe in what we had, despite everything."  
REVERSAL ||| Shift my weight forward, asserting my place ||| "I’ll decide how this ritual unfolds, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Close my eyes, focusing on the silence around us ||| mm
